gloss: to report; to inform; to cover (news)

definitions.gloss: to report; to inform; to cover (news)
definitions.explanation: To convey news or information, especially through media. A formal word used primarily in journalism and broadcasting.

examples.japanese: メディアが{事件|じけん}を{報|ほう}じた。
{新聞|しんぶん}が{大|おお}きく{報|ほう}じている。
examples.english: The newspapers are covering it extensively.

examples.japanese: {各局|かくきょく}のニュースが{一斉|いっせい}にこの{問題|もんだい}を{報|ほう}じたことで、{世間|せけん}の{注目|ちゅうもく}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Public attention gathered after all the news stations reported on this issue simultaneously.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal verb used primarily in media and journalism contexts. The alternative form {報|ほう}ずる also exists but is less common in modern Japanese. Often seen in passive form: 〜と{報|ほう}じられている (it is reported that ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事件|じけん}を{報|ほう}じる (to report an incident)
- 〜と{報|ほう}じられている (it is reported that ~)
- {大|おお}きく{報|ほう}じる (to cover extensively)
- {一斉|いっせい}に{報|ほう}じる (to report simultaneously)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {報道|ほうどう}する: to report (news) — more common as a する-verb
- {伝|つた}える: to convey, to report — broader usage, not limited to media
